description: This file defines functions related to audits within the supply chain management platform, including listing audits and scheduling new ones. It exports functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: listAudits()
methods.description: Returns a list of historical audits with tier information.

methods.name: scheduleAudit({ supplierId, level, date })
methods.description: Adds a new audit to the in-memory audits array with provided details.
